rail.aboutBody: Each card saves independently. Changes apply to the next hire order generated for this organization, not to documents already issued.

hireOrdersTab.disabled: Hire orders are not enabled for this organization. Contact your ShowFlow administrator to enable the module.

countersignCard.title: Countersign mode
countersignCard.description: How the artist's signature is captured once a hire order is issued.
countersignCard.loadError: Could not load the countersign settings.

letterheadCard.title: Letterhead
letterheadCard.description: Appears at the top of every hire order PDF alongside the Hiring party block.
letterheadCard.loadError: Could not load the letterhead settings.
letterheadCard.signatureUploaded: Signature uploaded. Save the letterhead to apply.
letterheadCard.agentSignatureHelp: A PNG of the booking agent's signature, drawn on the producer line of issued hire orders. Save the letterhead to apply.

numberingCard.title: Numbering
numberingCard.description: Controls the order number stamped on every hire order. Supported tokens: {prefix}, {yyyy}, {mm}, {dd}, {mmdd}, {seq}, {cast}, {cast|seq}.
numberingCard.loadError: Could not load the numbering settings.

orderDefaultsCard.title: Order defaults
orderDefaultsCard.description: Prefills a new hire order's fee, basis, and currency. A per-date fee is multiplied by the number of engagement dates on the order. A producer can always adjust it per order.
orderDefaultsCard.loadError: Could not load the order defaults.

pdfTemplateCard.title: PDF template
pdfTemplateCard.description: Wording, fonts, sizes, and colours for the hire order PDF. Edit any element and see the document update as you type. Changes apply to the next order issued, not to documents already issued.
pdfTemplateCard.loadError: Could not load the PDF template settings.

termsVariantsCard.title: Terms
termsVariantsCard.description: Templates of clauses printed on the hire order PDF. A hire order picks one template when it is issued, and one template is marked as the default. ShowFlow ships no default clauses, so your organization authors its own.
termsVariantsCard.loadError: Could not load the terms settings.
termsVariantsCard.noClauses: No clauses yet. Add the clauses your organization wants printed on a "{{label}}" hire order before issuing one.
termsVariantsCard.startFromTemplateHelp: Add a ready-made template to this organization. You own the copy, so editing it here changes nothing for anyone else.
termsVariantsCard.noTemplates: No templates yet. Add one to start authoring terms.

countersignFields.electronicBody: The artist reviews and signs the issued order in the app. Signature, timestamp and IP are stored with it.
countersignFields.manualBody: A producer marks the order countersigned once the artist has signed elsewhere.
countersignFields.emailProducersTitle: Also email producers the signed copy
countersignFields.emailProducersBody: When the artist signs, email the assigned producers a copy. Producers are notified in-app either way.
